verdict.rationale: Browserbase exposes a Downloads API to retrieve files (PDFs, spreadsheets) from agent runs and webhooks for event data, giving some data portability, but there's no documented comprehensive account/session data export in open formats for a full 'take everything and leave' scenario. missing for 10: full account data export tool, documented open-format export (e.g., session recordings, logs) beyond ad-hoc file downloads, explicit data-portability/lock-in-free policy.
